title: Pollen receipts and elevator controls
summary:
Enter got Pollen receipts, familiar model names got newer versions, and image and text routing got a less optimistic view of their backends.

A Quests contribution added transaction history to Enter: the Pollen page shows five recent entries, while Activity offers a paginated history with model, API key, and Pollen deduction details. The Sirius Cybernetics elevator game now defaults to faster-responding Mistral and lets players choose among four models.

The `glm` slug now selects GLM-5.2 with a listed 1,048,576-token context. Clean slugs across the OpenAI, Claude, Grok, Kimi, MiniMax, Mistral, and Gemini families now select newer versions; displaced models remain available through versioned slugs. Callers using the affected names may see different model behavior and pricing.

Z-Image routing now gives faster backends more requests without sending everything to one server. Separate latency records keep that weighting intact across heartbeats. Klein also returns a useful HTTP 400 error when a reference image is malformed or cannot be opened, rather than a server error.

highlights.title: Your Pollen transaction history
highlights.text: See recent deductions on the Pollen page, then open Activity for a paginated history with the model, API key, and amount for each entry. [Open Enter](https://enter.pollinations.ai/keys).

highlights.title: GLM moves to 5.2
highlights.text: `glm` now selects GLM-5.2, with a listed context of 1,048,576 tokens. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=glm).

highlights.title: Clean slugs, newer models
highlights.text: Names like `openai-large`, `claude-large`, `kimi`, and `mistral` now select newer models in their families. Earlier versions remain callable by versioned names. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: Choose your elevator guide
highlights.text: The Sirius Cybernetics elevator game now offers Mistral, OpenAI, DeepSeek, and Claude Fast in its model picker. Mistral is the faster-responding default.

highlights.title: Z-Image favors faster backends
highlights.text: Z-Image requests now favor GPUs with lower observed generation latency, while still sharing traffic across servers. [Try image generation](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
